log: Baseline: defined the goal framework (FRAMEWORK.md), requirements catalog (173 items from the stores' own numbering), synthetic benchmark (72 cases) and labeled real-app benchmark (14 apps); built the scorecard

AAB manifest decoding (aapt2 protobuf, verified against Google's own compiled schema on 6 real bundle manifests), APK decoding verified on a real APK, missing targetSdk defaults to minSdk (verified in Android docs), build/outputs artifacts now scanned, base-module-only for bundles
Framework change: added a 'file-format readers verified' sub-metric (10% of D2) with framework/readers.json

Manual checklist feature (--checklist, GUI tab): lists all 63 requirements that need a human/console/running app and all 66 not yet checked, for the stores in scope; moved requirements.json into the package

Packaging and CI: pyproject.toml (stdlib only, console scripts storecheck and storecheck-gui, package data), 3-OS x 2-Python GitHub Actions workflow, installed-copy check in the scorecard; portability fixes: finding paths are POSIX on every OS, all file reads force UTF-8, patches written as bytes

Verified the two remaining file-format readers against independent references on real data: ELF alignment vs readelf and pyelftools on 5 real libraries; PNG/JPEG sizes vs Pillow on 78 generated and 274 real images (0 mismatches). Removed a circular import between checks and checks_extra.

Requirement coverage batch 1 (Apple, verified from official sources): required-reason API declarations vs the app's own native code (Apple's per-category API lists), Apple's third-party SDK privacy-manifest list (87 SDKs), private APIs (2.5.1), non-WebKit browser engines (2.5.6), iPad support (2.4.1), IAP restore (3.1.1). 6 rules, 22 benchmark cases, 5 catalog items moved from unmapped to partial.

Requirement coverage batch 2 (policy-conflict checks, each verified from the official page): ads in extension targets (2.5.18), health data with ad SDKs (5.1.3), third-party SDKs in child-directed apps (1.3, 5.1.4, Google Families), VPN apps (5.4), screen recording consent (2.5.14), remote-website wrapper apps (Apple 4.2/4.2.2, Play Spam policy), WebView JavaScript interface (Play). 7 rules, 13 benchmark cases, 10 catalog items to partial, 1 new Google item.
Perf: skip translation/vector/data suffixes (.strings,.svg,.pdf,...) when loading signal text; slowest real scan was 9.8s of 10s

Requirement coverage batch 3: MusicKit usage key (4.5.2, added to usage-strings rule, key doc verified via DocC), crypto wallet/mining note (3.1.5), keyboard extension note (4.4.1); text verified from guidelines page; 7 synthetic cases; new generic ios_signal_note check

D5 stack reach: 17 new real apps (KMP, SwiftUI, RN, Capacitor, Cordova, Unity, MAUI, Godot, NativeScript); new readers for .NET MAUI (TFM target API, MacCatalyst ignored, generated plist keys), Godot (export_presets.cfg: target sdk, permissions, iOS plist), NativeScript, KMP, Capacitor ts config. Defects found by scanning and fixed: desktop x86_64 .so flagged as Android 16KB, xcframework plists as apps, Amplitude pattern matched shader/GDScript words, .gitignore as SDK evidence, minified bundles trigger UGC, project-level deployment target overridden by targets, Cordova geolocation 2.x default key, Xcode CI lint jobs claimed blocked uploads, LFS pointer icons. NewPipe relabelled android-native (it is not KMP).
Fix: Amplitude pattern no longer matches a quoted property name (BoatAttack WaterSurfaceDataEditor.cs); matches only dependency declarations and SDK API names

Built both AI jobs: judgment checks (--assess: 4 topics) and drafts/fix notes (--draft-listing, --explain), all behind guardrails (grounded quotes, redaction, local-only, policy-checked listing text); new D9 dimension (weights D1/D2 -5 each), 18 guardrail cases, 10-case live eval set; perf: skip Unity scene YAML in signal text

Requirement coverage batch 4: Apple Pay entitlement (4.9, verified entitlement name via DocC), OTA code updates (2.5.2), Matter (2.5.17), template services (4.2.6), remote desktop (4.2.7), emulators/mini apps (4.7), Safari extensions (4.4.2); 7 rules, 15 benchmark cases, 7 items to partial; guideline text read from Apple's page

Batch 4 fixes: remote-desktop pattern matched 'NoVNC' inside base64 (localsend cert.rs); emulator pattern matched a libretro URL in a shader comment (sourceofmana); skip Tiled/Godot scene and shader files (8 MB of .tmx pushed a scan to 11 s); social-app expo-updates labelled tp

CATALOG CORRECTION (not tool progress): removed the 6 Apple guideline numbers whose own text is 'Intentionally omitted' (2.5.7, 2.5.10, 4.2.4, 4.2.5, 4.4.3, 4.6). They are numbering gaps, not requirements, so they never could be checked. Catalog 174 -> 168 items.

Requirement coverage batch 5 (Google): Play Ads policy (location only for ads, lock-screen ads, overlay ads, persistent ids next to ad SDK, advertising-ID opt-out) and SDK requirements (IMEI/IMSI/SIM serial); 6 rules, 14 benchmark cases, google.ads and google.sdk_policy to partial; policy text read from the Play pages (Ads 9857753, SDK Requirements 13323374)

Perf: substring prefilter for literal-alternation patterns and cached file searches (scans were creeping to 11-12 s as rules were added; slowest now 7 s). Verified behavior unchanged: 127 tests and the real corpus labels.

D6: CI passes on ubuntu, macOS and Windows (Python 3.10, 3.13) at c8e71c6 after fixing Windows-only bugs (screenshot finding used backslashes; tests read default encoding and wrote patches in text mode); recorded all three OSes as observed with the run URL

D3: verified 7 more SDK/API mapping groups (11 -> 18 of 26): Stripe against its own mobile SDK privacy page and 3DS2 device page (removed purchase_history, made payment/contact/user ID usage-dependent, added device ID and product interaction), and device-ID, location, camera, audio, contacts, health API rows against both stores' data type definitions and their 'collect = leaves the device' definition. AppsFlyer, Branch, Amplitude, Segment, PostHog not verified: vendor sites are blocked or behind a bot wall.
